entries.carrier: Erie Insurance (Erie Insurance Exchange / Erie Insurance Property & Casualty); cyber reinsured by Hartford Steam Boiler
entries.title: Cyber Suite | Erie Insurance
entries.notes: No public form was found. Cyber Suite is an extra-cost endorsement available only on ErieSecure Business policies. It covers data breach, computer fraud and attack, cyber extortion, misdirected payment fraud and telecom fraud, plus privacy incident liability, network security liability and electronic media liability. It is reinsured by HSB, so the wording is likely based on HSB's Cyber Suite, and it is not offered in New York. An alias URL also exists: https://www.erieinsurance.com/business-insurance/cybersuite.

entries.title: Business Data Breach Coverage | Erie Insurance
entries.notes: No public form was found. This is an earlier or separate data-breach response coverage, offered with CyberScout, that pays for notification, legal and forensic costs and credit monitoring. Cyber Suite on ErieSecure Business may now replace it (not confirmed).
